title: Senior Applied AI Engineer
description: Lumen Finance is building AI assistants for small-business accounting. As a Senior Applied AI Engineer you will design and ship retrieval-augmented generation features in Python, own our evaluation pipeline, and work with product to turn customer workflows into agentic features. You will: build RAG services with FastAPI and Azure OpenAI; design offline evaluations and regression tests for LLM output; instrument production quality and cost. You have: 6+ years of software engineering in Python; shipped LLM applications to production; experience with vector search and evaluation. Hybrid: two days a week in our London office.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, AI
description: Harbour Systems deploys AI agents for logistics companies. Forward Deployed Engineers sit with customers, understand their operations, and build production integrations and agent workflows on our platform. You will lead technical discovery workshops, write Python services and tool integrations, and feed what you learn back to our product team. Requirements: senior software engineering background in Python; experience building LLM applications or agents; comfortable presenting to customer engineering teams. Based in our London office with occasional client visits in the UK.

title: Lead AI Engineer, Clinical Copilot
description: Meridian Health builds copilots for clinicians. We are hiring a Lead AI Engineer (individual contributor, tech lead for a team of four engineers) to own our LLM platform: retrieval over clinical guidelines, tool use, guardrails and evaluation. Day to day you will write Python, review designs, and set up evaluation and monitoring for model changes. Experience we need: 7+ years in software engineering, production LLM or RAG systems, strong testing habits. Fully remote within the UK; quarterly team days in London.

title: AI Platform Engineer (LLM Applications)
description: Quill Legal helps law firms search and draft with AI. You will build the platform our LLM features run on: retrieval pipelines, prompt and model management, evaluation harnesses, and the APIs product teams use. Stack: Python, FastAPI, Postgres, Azure, Terraform, GitHub Actions. You have built and operated LLM applications in production and care about evaluation and reliability. Senior level. Hybrid, London office three days a week.

title: AI Engineer (German speaking)
description: Brandt Mobility is expanding its AI team in London to serve our DACH customers. You will build RAG and agent features in Python for German-language documents and work daily with customer teams in Germany and Austria. Requirements: fluent German (written and spoken) is essential for this role, as all customer communication is in German; 5+ years Python; production LLM experience.

title: Enterprise Account Executive, AI Solutions
description: As an Enterprise Account Executive you will own a territory of UK enterprise accounts and sell our AI platform. You will carry an annual sales quota of £1.5M, build pipeline, run commercial negotiations, and close new business. Requirements: 5+ years in enterprise software sales with a record of exceeding quota; understanding of AI and cloud; excellent negotiation skills. Uncapped commission.

title: Graduate AI Engineer
description: Join our 2027 graduate programme as a Graduate AI Engineer. Over two years you will rotate through our data, platform and AI teams, receive structured training, and learn to build machine learning and LLM features. Requirements: a degree in computer science or a related subject awarded in 2025 or later; some Python from university projects. No professional experience required.

title: Research Scientist, Pretraining
description: Aurora AI Lab is hiring Research Scientists to advance large-scale pretraining. You will design and run experiments on model architectures, optimisation and scaling laws across thousands of accelerators, and publish at top venues. Requirements: PhD in machine learning or a related field; first-author publications at NeurIPS, ICML or ICLR; deep experience with distributed training in JAX or PyTorch.

title: Head of AI Engineering
description: We are looking for a Head of AI Engineering to lead three teams (around 25 engineers and managers). This is a leadership role with no hands-on coding: you will set strategy, hire and develop managers, own the budget, and report to the CTO. Requirements: 5+ years managing engineering managers; experience running large engineering organisations; ability to communicate with executives.

title: Senior iOS Engineer
description: Pocket Travel is hiring a Senior iOS Engineer to build our consumer travel app. You will work in Swift and SwiftUI, own features end to end, and collaborate with designers on animations and accessibility. Requirements: 5+ years building iOS apps in Swift; experience with Core Data, Combine and App Store releases. Hybrid in London.
